watch.summary: A streamer excitedly brags to his viewers after a female teammate promises to check out his stream, only to get killed instantly when the round starts.

beats.what: A teammate asks if the creator is streaming right now.
Teammate says she'll check him out, and the creator excitedly turns to camera to brag to his chat.
The round starts and he pushes aggressively down the corridor.
He gets shot and killed instantly without landing a hit.
The creator deadpans that he still sucks regardless of who checks him out.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Guys, they're coming to check me out!
watch.why: The instant flip from premature pride to immediate failure is a classic comedy beat. His deadpan self-deprecation right after dying lands the joke perfectly.
